I've answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team. Marcus is in that channel, so he could already see it. None of the shared files I can see give a Brackenwater renewal date, so I had nothing to check it against. I said so in the reply and suggested he confirm with Ilse before updating the account sheet.
